title: [Master]-"Your license does not grant you the following permissions on TableData 17 G/L Entry: Modify" if you Update Registers from G/L Registers page for old entries with G/L Register No. = 0.
summary: Updated G/L Register table permissions to allow modifying entries with register number 0 when updating from the G/L Registers page.
key_points: Modified table 45 G/L Register in multiple layers (W1, ES, APAC)
Addresses permission validation issue when updating historical entries
Fixes error preventing users from modifying G/L Register records with register number 0
